package: package a sequence of xm.Packageable objects into xm.Executable objects routed to appropriate cloud or local packaging mechanisms
review__packaging_router: review the _packaging_router function that dispatches packageables to cloud or local packagers based on executor spec
build_bazel_targets: build bazel targets from a sequence of packageables and collect their outputs for packaging
test_package: test the package function with VertexSpec, LocalSpec, and KubernetesSpec executor specifications
refactor__packaging_router: refactor _packaging_router to support additional executor spec types beyond VertexSpec, LocalSpec, and KubernetesSpec
